_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check_licenses.py. Every entry needs name + a non-empty reason; optional: version, license (exact string as printed by the script). Entries only downgrade non-OK findings. Engineering review, not legal advice - see docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md.

allow.name: certifi
allow.reason: MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft; certifi is used unmodified as a separate installed package, so Athena OS source is not affected. Keep certifi's LICENSE with the image. Reviewed in docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md.

allow.name: tqdm
allow.reason: tqdm is 'MPL-2.0 AND MIT' (MPL covers only some files); used unmodified as a separate package. Reviewed in docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md.
